action_summary: Compose the verified goal-variant admission path with main's structural binder and word-accounting refusal. The exact taught template and verified variants keep their own admission; the wider structural/synonym fallback is guarded against negation, conditionals and extra destructive actions. A capability word-accounting refusal no longer silences a verified taught workflow that accounts for the whole sentence; the workflow still executes confined and must pass its own postcondition. Local targeted regression: 237 passed, 2 skipped, 8 subtests; repo-integrity static PASS. No capability, benchmark, family or terminal credit is claimed.
